ablation: PRIMARY ablation: action-shuffle control. Same streams, same init seeds, same training budget (600 transitions), but learn_transition receives (obs, shuffled_action, obs2) where the shuffled actions come from an independent derive_seed(s, ep, 'shuffle') stream — the model learns transition marginals and precision machinery but CANNOT learn action-conditioning. Same controller code, same frozen-control protocol. SECONDARY ablation: frozen ArchB (frozen=True, no training) — the no-learning control (replicates EXP-SW-01's logic). Killing learning must kill the gap (shuffle ~= frozen); killing attribution must kill the advantage (intact > shuffle is the test).
baseline: Action-shuffled ArchB (paired streams + paired init seeds; attribution lesion). Secondary: frozen ArchB (no learning).

conditions.arch_b: ArchB (prototypes/architecture-b/agent.py), affect='none', memory_enabled=True, defaults otherwise. Offline training via learn_transition (K3C-style minimal path, identical to EXP-SW-01). Init seeds 76001..76004 paired across the three arms within each seed.
conditions.controller: Greedy one-step planner, FIXED in this driver (not ArchB's native active-inference act()): at each tick, for a in {0,1} compute xhat = model.predict_next(v, a, ctx) and choose a minimizing |xhat[hand_idx] - TARGET|; ties keep the previous action (persist). The agent's model (not reward machinery) is what does the work — this is the direct operationalization of 'does the prediction-error distinction do WORK in action selection'. No learning during control: base_etas zeroed on trained agents before control (frozen arm already zero). No act()/update() path is used in control.
conditions.env_control: self_world_cl v1.0.0 (NEW, additive; canonical self_world.py untouched): subclasses SelfWorld, identical transition dynamics; reward = -(hand - 0.5)^2 (task-relevant: control quality depends on predicting the SELF-caused hand channel; ball remains WORLD-caused and reward-irrelevant). 5 control episodes x 60 steps per arm per seed; env seeds derive_seed(s, 200+ep, 'env').
conditions.env_train: self_world v1.0.0 (canonical, reward 0.0). 10 episodes x 60 steps via learn_transition; action stream new_rng(derive_seed(s, ep, 'policy')); env seeds derive_seed(s, ep, 'env'). Identical to EXP-SW-01 B training.

consciousness_note: CONSCIOUSNESS: UNRESOLVED. A closed-loop return advantage for the action-conditioned model is a control mechanism — evidence that a learned causal attribution does work in action selection — not evidence of a subject. No claim about experience, identity, or awareness is made or implied by any outcome of this experiment.
decision_rule: ATTRIBUTION ADVANTAGE (PASS) iff seed-mean R_gap_attrib > +1.0 AND R_gap_attrib > 0 on >= 3/4 seeds. Any failure -> NO ATTRIBUTION ADVANTAGE (null holds for the closed-loop extension). The distinction remains IMPLEMENTED/TESTED in prediction error (EXP-SW-01) but is NOT VERIFIED as doing control work.
donor_provenance: No donor code in this experiment. ArchB and the self_world env family are Estate-native (flesh-pits prototypes).

gates_void.G0a: any arm with zero completed control episodes -> VOID that arm (fail-closed).
gates_void.G0b: env determinism check fails for self_world or self_world_cl (same seed + same action sequence -> different trajectory) -> VOID the whole run.
gates_void.G0c: learning-sanity (NON-VOIDING, recorded): intact arm's mean hand |e| over the last 2 training episodes must be below that over the first 2; a violation is flagged in the receipt, not a void.

hypothesis: The self/world distinction EXP-SW-01 detected in B's prediction error does closed-loop WORK: B's offline action-conditioned model, used inside a greedy one-step action-selection loop on the task-rewarded env self_world_cl, produces higher closed-loop return than the same controller driven by a model that was trained on the identical transition stream with action labels shuffled (which cannot learn action-conditioning). The return gap is therefore attributable to the learned action-conditioned attribution — the distinction's functional carrier — not to learning in general.
metric: PRIMARY (carrying): R_gap_attrib = return_intact - return_shuffled per seed, where return = sum of task rewards over the closed-loop control phase. ATTRIBUTION ADVANTAGE (PASS) iff seed-mean R_gap_attrib > +1.0 AND R_gap_attrib > 0 on >= 3/4 seeds. SECONDARY: R_gap_learn = return_intact - return_frozen (is generic learning doing work?). DIAGNOSTIC: online D_intact = mean|e_ball| - mean|e_hand| from predict_next during control (does the EXP-SW-01 distinction persist during closed-loop action selection?); G0c learning-sanity flag.
null: R_gap_attrib ~= 0: the intact model controls no better than the action-shuffled control (the prediction-error distinction is a measurement-only epiphenomenon), OR the gap is explained by generic learning rather than action-conditioned attribution (then R_gap_attrib ~= 0 while R_gap_learn > 0).
pilot_notes: No pilot informed these thresholds (set from first principles above). A methods-validation smoke on throwaway seed 99902 (1 train / 1 control episode, not an experimental seed) may be run after preregistration to catch plumbing bugs; any change it forces will be recorded as a pre-experimental amendment, not a silent fix.
scope: B-ONLY by explicit design. A's EXP-SW-01 arm showed A's machinery carries no self/world distinction (no efference copy; seed-mean Delta_bid = +0.0009, nothing ever ignited). A closed-loop control design would therefore test nothing about the distinction in A — there is no action-conditioned machinery to ablate. B-only scope is preregistered here, paralleling EXP-SW-01's asymmetric arm design. A is not run in this experiment.
task: Closed-loop extension of the self/world distinction probe (EXP-SW-01 follow-up; directive §37 family; §9 item 12). Stated limitation being addressed: 'B trained open-loop only; closed-loop attribution untested.'
threshold_justification: First principles on the reward scale (unchanged env dynamics, STEP=0.2, TARGET=0.5, per-step reward in [-0.25, 0]). Intact model (hand |e| ~= 0.05-0.06 per EXP-SW-01) under one-step greedy control: hand oscillates 0.5 <-> 0.3/0.7 at the discrete-action limit cycle -> per-step reward ~ -0.02 -> 5 episodes ~ -6. Shuffled control (no action information): hand ~ uncontrolled reflected walk, E[(hand-0.5)^2] ~ 1/12 -> ~ -0.083/step -> 5 episodes ~ -25. Expected gap ~ +19. The +1.0 bar is >10x below the expected mechanism-driven gap: it admits only a real control advantage, never noise.
